reviews.content:
I am actually stunned! I've been looking for years for an app that does this and I could not find a better one than the built-in Microsoft Voice Typing which only supports English and no other functionalities besides transcribing. 

This one blows it out of the water! I still cannot believe how fantastic it is and to find it in all places in Windhawk wasn't on my bingo card.

I cannot recommend enough. Five stars is an understatement for my rating.
Thank you so much. Keep up the fantastic work!
